subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 5: Culture – Unusual schools around the world
outcomes: Describe unusual schools around the world.
Compare your school with schools in other countries.
Plan and describe a perfect school.

tf.s: In Bangladesh, some children study at school on a boat.
tf.why: Yes! A boat school helps when there are floods.

tf.s: The boat school is in the USA.
tf.why: The boat school is in Bangladesh.

tf.s: At a boarding school, children sleep at school on weekdays.
tf.why: Correct! They go home at the weekend or for holidays.

tf.s: At Forest School, children have an outdoor lesson once a week.
tf.why: Great! They learn outside, for example looking at leaves.

tf.s: The school in the USA uses a lot of books and paper.
tf.why: That school never uses books or paper. Children use computers.

tf.s: A school in Indonesia teaches children using examples from nature.
tf.why: Well done! Nature is their teacher.

tf.s: Children at a boarding school go home every evening.
tf.why: They sleep at school on weekdays and go home at the weekend.

tf.s: Some schools in Bangladesh are on boats because there are sometimes floods.
tf.why: Yes! Floods make it hard to get to school.

tf.s: An outdoor lesson happens inside the classroom.
Forest School lessons are about nature.
tf.why: Right! Children look at leaves and nature outside.

boxes.why: Some children in Bangladesh study on a boat.

boxes.q: Why do some children study on a boat?
boxes.why: Floods make it hard to reach a normal school.

boxes.q: Which school never uses books or paper?
Where do boarding school children sleep on weekdays?
boxes.why: They sleep at school and go home at the weekend.

boxes.q: What do children do at Forest School?
boxes.why: They learn outside once a week.

boxes.q: In Indonesia, a school uses examples from ___.
How often is the outdoor lesson at Forest School?

o: We have an outdoor lesson once a week.
We has an outdoor lesson once a week.
We have once a week an outdoor lesson lesson.

boxes.why: We say: by boat, by bus, by car.

mcq.q: Where do some children study on a boat?
mcq.why: The boat school is in Bangladesh.

mcq.q: When do boarding school children go home?
o: at the weekend or for holidays
mcq.why: They sleep at school on weekdays.

mcq.q: Which school teaches children using examples from nature?
mcq.why: The school in Indonesia uses nature.

mcq.q: What do children use at the school in the USA?
mcq.why: That school never uses books or paper.

mcq.q: A child says: 'I sleep at school from Sunday to Thursday.' What kind of school is it?
mcq.why: Sleeping at school on weekdays = boarding school.

mcq.q: A child says: 'Today we look at leaves outside.' Which school is it?
mcq.why: Forest School has outdoor lessons about nature.

mcq.q: Write about your perfect school: we go outside two days a week.
o: We have an outdoor lesson twice a week.
We have an outdoor lesson once a week.
We never have an outdoor lesson.
We have an outdoor lesson every day.
mcq.why: Two days a week = twice a week.

mcq.q: How is a boarding school different from most schools in Oman?
o: Children sleep at school on weekdays.
Children only study at the weekend.
mcq.why: Good comparing! Boarding school children stay at school.

mcq.q: Why is a boat school a good idea in a place with floods?
o: Children can still get to school when there is water.
There are no teachers on land.
mcq.why: A boat can float on flood water.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a good reason why a school is 'perfect'?
o: We never go outside or read.
mcq.why: A good reason tells something nice and useful about the school.
